findings.evidence: Line 132: `have := HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.of_dvd (ZMod p) (hd.trans hp.exponent_dvd)` — the only use of `hd`, composed straight into `p - 1`. Mathlib's instance `HasEnoughRootsOfUnity (ZMod p) (p - 1)` (Mathlib/RingTheory/ZMod/Torsion.lean:27) plus `of_dvd` needs exactly `d ∣ p - 1`.
findings.fix: State `theorem exists_isPrimitiveRoot_of_dvd_sub_one (hp : IsGoodDixonPrime G p) {d : ℕ} (hd : d ∣ p - 1) : ∃ ζ : ZMod p, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ d`, dropping `.trans hp.exponent_dvd` from the proof, and derive `exists_isPrimitiveRoot := hp.exists_isPrimitiveRoot_of_dvd_sub_one hp.exponent_dvd`.
findings.issue: `exists_isPrimitiveRoot_of_dvd_exponent` assumes `hd : d ∣ Monoid.exponent G`, but the proof immediately discards it via `hd.trans hp.exponent_dvd` and only uses `d ∣ p - 1`. The stronger hypothesis makes the lemma inapplicable to divisors of `p - 1` that are not divisors of the exponent — including `d = p - 1` itself, and including the output of its own neighbour `orderOf_dvd_sub_one` (line 122) without a detour through `Monoid.order_dvd_exponent`.

summary: The predicate, its API, and the residue-window file sit at the right level, and the PR is strictly more general than the roadmap's suggested signatures (no [Fintype G], finiteness derived). One lemma assumes divisibility of the exponent where its proof only uses divisibility of p - 1.
